mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 59 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School, making for a lovely afternoon.
The City of Verona is working on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes updates to water mains, sanitary sewers, and new sidewalks between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue.
We have Yoga at Insight Wellness taking place today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.
On October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by.
